mostWorthwhile.text: Building the supplied bone cutaway was most worthwhile: it brought mineral-reinforced collagen, living cells and a vessel together while keeping their locations distinct.

leastWorthwhile.text: The intermediate collagen-and-cells assembly felt somewhat repetitive; it mainly changed which existing constituents were highlighted before mineral was added.

surprise.text: It was interesting that some matrix-producing osteoblasts become embedded osteocytes with processes extending through tiny channels.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the supplied compatible options guided the choices rather than requiring discovery. The channels were shown connecting cells to vessel surroundings, but what passes through them was not explained.

continue.text: I would continue to see how muscles produce movement at the supported joint; this chapter made the joint’s structures clear but did not show what powers its movement.
